data.description: 打烊后的酒馆里，斯卡蒂穿着黑色连衣裙与暗红衬里的黑外套坐在长椅上。她端着未动的酒杯，另一手留在裙边，琥珀色灯光照着松开的衣襟。

data.promptProse: On the tavern bench, Skadi holds an untouched glass in one hand, the other beside her skirt; amber lamps light her loose neckline and dark-red coat lining. Faint light from the distant windows remains behind the amber-lit bench.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 酒馆深夜
